$comment: Sample data for the Shore Excursion Booking exercise, sailing S1. The two sources are deliberately inconsistent: EX-100 clean happy path; EX-200 in catalog but missing from inventory; EX-300 price mismatch (catalog 109 vs inventory 119); EX-400 oversold (sold 10 > capacity 8); EX-500 sold out exactly; EX-600 departs within 48h of 'today' (2026-06-25), local time with no offset. 'reconciledResponse' is the actual GET /sailings/S1/excursions output from stage 2.
